Hyve/Asteroid-14 is home to the largest bee colonies in the region. Many companies have attempted to harvest honey from the massive beehives here. The locals however were not fond of intruders.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Abandoned.. for good reason.

CONDITIONS: Rocky terrain highly populated by bee hives.

FAUNA: Bees, lots and lots of bees.

Also known as Asteroid-14.

> Environment

Hyve has rocky terrain with patches of tall brown grass, flowers, and an overwhelming number of bee hives that range from small to colossal in size. Several small lakes of honey can also be found around the exterior that generally hinder the movement speed of players, and this honey can be present in the interior depending on what interior is generated. The ecosystem is dominated by bees, including species like the Honey Stinger, and they can be seen flying overhead or around their hives.

Buildings with hexagonal tiling resembling honeycombs can also be found around the exterior. The buildings northeast, southeast, and south of the ship are fire exits while the taller building northwest of and behind the ship is the main entrance.

> Weather

Hyve can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default.

Hyve experiences a unique Foggy weather. A swarm of bees will continously surround players in a circular formation with a denser and darker shade of fog, though it being pitch black in some instances may be unintended. Though the bees will always follow the player, the fog can still be flown out of with a jetpack.

Hyve also experiences a unique Flooded weather. Instead of the water level rising throughout the day, a swarm of gigantic bees will move from the far right side to the far left side of the exterior throughout the day. Players that go too deep into this swarm of bees will rapidly take 3 damage per hit and have drastically reduced visibility. The player is not safe within the ship, and the bees envelop the ship around 04:00pm and pass at around 04:30pm. It is possible to fly over the bees safely with a jetpack.

Foggy and Flooded Bees Buzzing

> Moon Exclusive Content

Inside & Outside Ambience

On Hyve you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

Outside Ambience

Inside Ambience

Large Hives

Hyve's exterior has many large hives that can be broken by driving the cruiser into them. This will spawn several additional Circuit Bees and hives that can be collected for scrap as usual. Breaking these hives can also spawn entities, such as Honey Stingers and Old Birds.

Interior's Unique Hazard

Hyve's interior has hives on pedestals that can not be collected as scrap. At 06:00pm, bees begin expanding and contracting around this hive. Any player that steps within the area the bees are around will rapidly take 3 damage per hit.

Major Story Spoilers: Decision Aftermath

If players decided to overload and blow up ResearcherxB, debris from the ship can fall onto Hyve's exterior. If players land on Hyve in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Inserting the Hyve videotape that can be found within breakable hives on the exteriors of Centrus, Chasm, Faith, Filitrios, Glace, Lecaro, Motra, or Release into the projector in Galetry. Lecaro is the only moon that is guaranteed to spawn a breakable hive.
Alternatively, the Hyve videotape randomly spawns as scrap within the interior of Vow.

Unlocks

Junic: Junic videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.

Hyve Videotape

This videotape can be found by breaking the hive that is guaranteed to spawn on the exterior of Lecaro and has a chance to spawn on the exteriors of Chasm, Filitrios, and Motra. It can also randomly spawn as scrap within the interior of Vow.
